title: Integrated industrial robot arm and powered gripper
summary: A fixed public anchor task measuring how an LLM plans, embodies, verifies, and documents a manufacturable machine-tending robot arm with an integrated powered opening/closing gripper.

candidateScope: fixed base and complete manipulator arm
wrist and electrically powered two-contact opening/closing gripper; pneumatic primary actuation is prohibited because no pneumatic catalogue family is supplied
kinematics, load paths, drives, brakes, bearings and structure
critical manufacturing definition, tolerances, inspection and service
complete fixed neutral geometry, closed component-interface cards, and fixed foundation/contact acceptance
hash-bound static STEP/kinematics handoff, CSG-checked grasp coordinates, closed actuator/rating cards, and frozen evidence-only common method for cycle/collision/accuracy claims
